fix_subject: When flattening a view that is the right operand of a LEFT JOIN, using the optimization of check-in [41c27bc0ff1d3135], always insert the TK_IF_NULL_ROW expression nodes, even for TK_COLUMN expressions, as the TK_COLUMN might be a column from an outer query and hence still need to be NULLed out. This fixes the problem described by [forum:/forumpost/26387ea7ef|forum post 26387ea7ef].
